When non-zero, emits a CPU trace scope around each CrowdyState delta decode.

Runs every automated gate and prints one PASS/FAIL report to copy in a single selection: the one-shot action path, the view-state echo (a pose landing, a second echo changing it, a pose touching nothing else, a pose clearing, a hostile echo in every field being unable to unmake an entity, a truncated payload, a forged payload), the renderer's animation track count across a spawn and destroy churn, whether every authored pose resolves to a bank slot of its own, the CrowdyState delta path into an entity that owns no participant (which road actually wrote the pose, what was dropped, and whether a field registered from outside this module receives its bytes), and any gate a game has registered.

Shortest span a remote segment may be replayed over, in seconds.
